rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial cycle runs from licensure to the end of the birth month in the even/odd year matching the birth year; the same hour minimum applies to the initial cycle.
rules.carryover: Not allowed: hours above the minimum do not carry forward.
rules.alternatives: Written extension request for extenuating circumstances at least 7 days before the cycle ends.
rules.audit_note: Professional development portfolio kept by the licensee; random and designated audits - portfolio due within 60 days. Keep documentation for the current and previous cycle.
rules.rule_quote: The minimum number of required hours of fundamental and elective activities for each initial or biennial cycle is 50 hours for dentists and dental therapists and 25 hours for dental hygienists and licensed dental assistants.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Fundamental (min 30 h): clinical seminars, webinars, symposiums, lectures, basic science college courses (max 15 h), infection control, Board-approved activities. Elective (max 20 h): conventions (3 h each), volunteer work, professional reading/self-study, teaching/scholarly work, practice management, board/association leadership (3 h).

topics.who: All licensees: an infection control course is mandatory each cycle (fundamental activity)
Consecutive, current CPR certified at renewal

rules.notes: License expires the last day of the birth month (even/odd year matching birth year). Must certify consecutive, current CPR at renewal. Sedation/GA certificate holders: +15 h in anesthesia-related areas per cycle.
